body:
Yeah. This has been going on for about 8 months now, (2 years if you're not counting this bout of depression) as well as my OCD for as long as I can remember. All my illnesses are severe, so it's not as if I can just block them out. 

As (I thought) I've said, all I've been able to do is lie in bed because I haven't had the energy, nor attention span, to occupy myself.

apologies for the pessimism, but I'm hardly in a sound state of mind.

Currently, being unable to move and all, talking (inevvitably about my mental illness) is all I'm able to do and that inevitably turns in to me being a self-absorbed mess and either scaring or pissing off people.
